title: Governance-State Corruption in Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents: A Cross-Model Stress Test
title_zh: LLM智能体长期记忆中的治理状态损坏：跨模型压力测试

paragraphs.en: 跨模型压力测试揭示LLM智能体长期记忆存在治理状态损坏问题，可显著降低下游任务正确率。 An LLM agent can retrieve a memory correctly yet use it incorrectly after its validity state changes. We study governance-state corruption: faults that alter which retained records enter model-visible context while stored content and tasks remain fixed. Across six providers, 731 benchmark-grounded bases yield 2,080 matched fault pairs. In offline control-plane checks, corruption changes the operative projection in 96.25% of pairs, while oracle-backed enforcement restores it in 100%. For downstream evaluation, a deterministically selected, non-probability LongMemEval/Memora panel resolves 298 of 300 matched triplets (238 distinct bases). Clean-minus-corrupted contrasts are 40.54 percentage points in LongMemEval binary correctness (95% base-cluster interval [30.32, 50.71]) and 30.60 points in rescaled Memora FAMA ([23.31, 37.69]); both sources also show recovery. OAKS Novel native option parity holds for all 6,714 resolved outputs. Full-cohort frozen-scorer corruption/recovery effects (-27.55/+27.51 points) remain descriptive proxies, not validated native semantic population effects. These bounded findings motivate evaluating memory control-state integrity alongside retrieval accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 跨模型压力测试揭示LLM智能体的长期记忆存在治理状态损坏问题，可显著降低下游任务正确率。LLM智能体可能正确检索到某条记忆，但在其有效性状态发生变化后错误地使用它。 我们研究治理状态损坏：这类故障会改变哪些留存记录进入模型可见的上下文，而存储内容和任务保持不变。 在六家提供商上，731个基于基准的基础案例产生了2,080个匹配的故障对。 在离线控制平面检查中，损坏在96.25%的配对中改变了操作性投影，而由预言机支撑的强制执行在100%的配对中将其恢复。 在下游评估中，一个确定性选择、非概率抽样的LongMemEval/Memora面板解决了300个匹配三元组中的298个（238个不同基础案例）。 干净减损坏的对比在LongMemEval二元正确率上为40.54个百分点（95%基础聚类区间[30.32, 50.71]），在重新标度的Memora FAMA上为30.60个百分点（[23.31, 37.69]）；两个数据源也都显示出恢复效果。 OAKS Novel原生选项一致性在全部6,714个已解决的输出上成立。 全队列冻结评分器的损坏/恢复效应（-27.55/+27.51个百分点）仍属于描述性代理指标，而非经过验证的原生语义总体效应。 这些有边界的发现促使我们在评估检索准确率的同时，也评估记忆控制状态的完整性。
